description: React component for managing annotation layer modal dialog in Apache Superset frontend, including create/edit functionality with form validation and resource fetching.

classes.name: AnnotationLayerModal
classes.description: React functional component for annotation layer modal dialog, supporting add/edit modes, form validation, and resource operations.

methods.name: resetLayer
methods.description: Resets the current layer state to default empty values.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides the modal and resets the layer state.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Handles saving the layer, either creating or updating via API calls.

methods.name: onTextChange
methods.description: Updates current layer state on input change.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates form input to enable or disable save button.
